'''''Last Shot''''' is a [[canon]] novel written by [[Daniel José Older]] that serves as a tie-in to the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Anthology'']] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''. The novel was first published by [[Del Rey]] on [[April 17]], 2018 in hardcover, and it was released in paperback on [[October 30]], 2018.
